ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio characterized by a dominant high-intensity white central region (~70% of surface area) bounded by low-intensity black peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white interior polygon surrounded by irregular black pigmentation bands along the trailing edge and lateral tips. Surface contains a heterogeneous distribution of discrete dark circular and annular pixel clusters across the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees and a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, exhibiting non-uniform peak-to-valley pixel variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex leading/lower edges tapering to acute lateral tips with a slight posterior-oriented sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular/annular dark-on-white pixel markings distributed across both lobes, with the highest concentration in the upper-outer quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread circular scarring across the ventral surface; unique reddish-brown circular focal point located in the medial-lower region of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct reddish-brown pigmentation spot on the left fluke lobe that contrasts with the surrounding grayscale pixel environment.
